## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 are correctly grounded, but source-30 states the numerical count only conditionally on Conjecture 4.10.
- claim-3 proves the literal equality \(J_{v_m}=I_{w_m}\) in the same integral graded ring \(A_m\), hence preserves generator number there. It does not establish the essential numerical premise
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}.
  \]
- claim-4 correctly identifies that no exact accepted internal theorem or proof supplying this numerical equality was provided. Inclusion-minimality of the displayed family is insufficient.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] For every \(m\ge1\), prove or invoke with an exact validated locator that
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}})=\binom{2m}{m},
  \qquad A_m=H^\ast(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z).
  \]
  If the invoked theorem is formulated instead in \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\), also prove that passage to \(A_m\) preserves this homogeneous generator number before applying \(J_{v_m}=I_{w_m}\).
